blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.
blocks.zh: 电影多镜头录像制作既需要叙事规划,也需要迭代完善. 现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理,要么依赖没有政策更新的向导工作流程。 在本文中,我们提出CineEvorve,这是电影多镜头录像制作的代理性自我演进框架,它统一了导演和在单一视觉语言政策范围内的批评. 模拟现实世界的电影制作 以批判性的反馈 互相反复引导 我们通过交替的强化学习来训练CineEvolve 在那里,导演 表面的缺陷使批评更加尖锐, 更新的批评 指导导演的目标修改。 为了稳定共同演变,我们引入了E-GRPO(E-GRPO),利用历史锚地和修订保障来缓解优势通胀. 此外,我们贡献了CineTraj,一个40K电影轨迹数据集,涵盖创作、批评和修订。 广泛的实验表明,CineEvolve的绩效超过了现有方法。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video generation is rapidly advancing from isolated single clips toward long-horizon cinematic storytelling [ 18 ] .
In visual storytelling, narratives unfold through sequences of interconnected shots capturing dynamic events over shifting viewpoints and scenes.
Such multi-shot sequences demand cross-shot consistency to preserve characters and environments, alongside inter-shot coherence to ensure narrative progression [ 2 , 32 ] .
Satisfying these constraints requires coupling narrative planning with visual synthesis.
blocks.zh:
影片制作迅速从孤立的单片片段发展到长相电影故事化[18].
在视觉故事叙述中,叙事通过一系列互相关联的镜头展开,捕捉变化中的观点和场景的动态事件.
这种多镜头序列要求交叉镜头的一致性,以保持人物和环境,同时进行相拍的一致性,以确保叙事进展[2,32].
满足这些制约需要将叙事规划与视觉合成相配合.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, existing visual-based methods use video generation models to produce shots, relying on extended attention mechanisms or historical conditioning [ 28 , 27 , 17 ] .
In contrast, agentic-based methods use multimodal foundation models to plan the story structure and invoke external visual tools to render each shot [ 11 , 10 ] .
Despite these advancements, visual-based methods lack the narrative reasoning to rectify semantic errors, while agentic-based methods typically follow feed-forward workflows or use feedback for inference-time refinement, without updating their policies through training (Fig. 1 (a)).
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,现有的以视觉为基础的方法利用视频生成模型来制作镜头,依靠扩展的注意力机制或历史调制[28,27,17].
相形之下,以代理为基础的方法使用多模式基础模型来规划故事结构并引用外部视觉工具来渲染出每个镜头[11,10].
尽管取得了这些进步,但以视觉为基础的方法缺乏纠正语义错误的叙事推理,而以代理为基础的方法通常遵循向导工作流程或使用反馈来改进推断时间,而不通过培训更新其政策(图1(a))。

blocks.en:
To overcome this static limitation, a natural solution is to emulate real-world filmmaking, where directors iteratively refine defective shots through trial-and-error reflection.
However, visual closed-loop refinement poses practical challenges: external tools may subtly deviate from the narrative plan, and separate evaluators often struggle to assess these flaws without direct access to the creator’s intent.
Because cinematic planning and defect diagnosis share an understanding of cinematic grammar, we formulate multi-shot creation as an agentic self-evolution process with two roles: a Director for initial creation and targeted revision, and a Critic for defect diagnosis.
By unifying both roles within a single vision-language policy, the model can introspect against its own narrative goals, fostering cognitive synergy across both capabilities while enabling systematic feedback refinement to perfect multi-shot narratives (Fig. 1 (b)).
blocks.zh:
为了克服这种静态的限制,一个自然的解决办法是效仿现实世界的电影制作,导演们通过试镜和反射来迭代地完善有缺陷的镜头.
然而,视觉闭路改进带来了实际挑战:外部工具可能潜入地偏离了叙事计划,而单独的评估者往往在无法直接接触创作者意图的情况下,难以评估这些缺陷.
因为电影的策划和缺陷诊断对电影的语法有共同的理解,所以我们把多镜头创作作为代理自演过程,发挥两个作用:一个是初始创作和定向审校的主任,一个是对缺陷诊断的批评.
通过统一单一愿景语言政策中的两种作用,该模式可以对照其自身的叙事目标进行回顾,促进两种能力的认知协同作用,同时能够系统地改进反馈,以完善多镜头叙事(图1(b))。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present CineEvolve , an agentic self-evolution framework that uses external visual generation tools for cinematic multi-shot video synthesis through a unified vision-language policy acting as both Director and Critic.
Following the supervised warm-up, the unified policy evolves through alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director exposes failure cases to train the Critic, while the updated Critic provides diagnostic feedback to guide the Director.
Specifically, the Critic is optimized for dynamic storyboard rollouts using composite critic rewards to sharpen its diagnostic precision.
Meanwhile, the Director is trained across initial creation and targeted revision, guided by the updated Critic’s self-evaluative quality scores alongside narrative coherence and tool-executability rewards.
To mitigate intra-group advantage inflation during co-evolution, we propose Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), which calibrates advantage estimation via revision safeguarding and historical anchoring to ensure steady improvement.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍CineEvorve——一个代理性的自我演变框架,它通过统一的视觉语言政策,既作为导演,又作为批评者,利用外部视觉生成工具进行电影多镜头视频合成.
受监督的取暖后,统一政策通过交替强化学习来演进,由主任揭露出培养批评者的失败案例,而更新的批评提供诊断反馈来指导主任.
具体来说,"批评"被优化为动态的故事板推出,利用综合评论家奖赏来提升其诊断精度.
同时,主任接受初步创建和定向修订方面的培训,其指导是经过更新的批评者自我评价的质量分数以及叙事一致性和工具可执行性奖励。
为了减轻集团内部在共同演进期间的优势通胀,我们提出进化GRPO(E-GRPO),通过修订保障和历史锚地来校正优势估计,以确保稳步改善.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-Shot Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 多热视频生成

blocks.en:
Driven by the advancements of AI-assisted filmmaking, video synthesis is expanding from isolated clips toward multi-shot storytelling.
Multi-shot video generation broadly follows two paradigms: visual-based and agentic-based approaches.
Visual-based methods enforce continuity by synthesizing consecutive shots within unified spatio-temporal latents ( e.g . , HoloCine [ 18 ] , CineTrans [ 28 ] , MultiShotMaster [ 27 ] ) or conditioning on preceding visual frames ( e.g . , OneStory [ 2 ] , ShotStream [ 17 ] ).
While preserving visual persistence, they struggle to diagnose or rectify semantic narrative flaws.
Conversely, agentic methods leverage multimodal foundation models to schedule generative tools via structured planning ( e.g . , STAGE [ 32 ] , ViMax [ 11 ] ) or cinematic retrieval ( e.g . , FilMaster [ 10 ] ).
However, their feed-forward execution cannot adaptively rectify execution failures.
Although CineCrew [ 6 ] introduces diagnostic feedback for rule-based refinement, it lacks policy-level learning to evolve from errors.
In contrast, CineEvolve formalizes multi-shot synthesis as a closed-loop trial-and-error process, unifying Director and Critic within a single policy that co-evolves via reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh:
在AI辅助电影制作的进步的推动下,视频合成正在从孤立的片段向多镜头讲故事扩展.
多镜头视频生成大致遵循了两个范式:以视觉为基础的方法和以代理为基础的方法.
基于视觉的方法通过在统一的斯皮提-时空潜想中合成相接镜头来强制连续性(例如:HoloCine [18],CineTrans [28],多相相机Master [27]),或者在之前的视觉帧上进行调制(例如:OneStory [2],ShotStream [17]).
在保留视觉持久性的同时,他们也挣扎于诊断或纠正语义叙事缺陷.
反之,代理方法利用多模式基础模型,通过结构化规划(例如,STAGE[32],ViMax[11])或电影检索(例如,FilMaster[10])安排基因工具。
然而,它们的向导执行不能适应性地纠正执行失败.
虽然CineCrew [6]引入了诊断反馈,以进行有章可循的完善,但它缺乏政策层面的学习来从错误中演化出.
相形之下,CineEvorve将多镜头合成正式化为闭路试验和反射过程,将主任和批评者统一在一个通过强化学习共同演变的单一政策内.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agentic Self-Evolution Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理自演机制

blocks.en:
Agentic self-evolution empowers autonomous agents to continuously improve their capabilities via experiential trial-and-error and environmental feedback.
The vast majority of existing works confine self-evolution to non-visual domains, developing reflective strategies for textual reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and algorithmic tasks through external memory updates ( e.g . , ReasoningBank [ 20 ] , ACE [ 34 ] , RMM [ 25 ] ), prompt optimization ( e.g . , GEPA [ 1 ] , ERM [ 29 ] ), self-improving code synthesis ( e.g . , Darwin Gödel Machine [ 31 ] , Gödel Agent [ 30 ] ), or synthetic adversarial reasoning ( e.g . , R-Zero [ 9 ] , PasoDoble [ 35 ] ).
Recently, a handful of pioneering studies have begun exploring self-evolution in multimodal settings; however, these efforts remain largely limited to isolated 2D perception or static image interactions ( e.g . , VisPlay [ 8 ] , Agent0-VL [ 16 ] , ECHO [ 13 ] , JarvisEvo [ 15 ] ).
To our knowledge, CineEvolve represents the first endeavor to extend agentic self-evolution into multi-shot video generation, coupling creative direction and diagnostic critique to achieve iterative self-improvement in complex cinematic synthesis.
blocks.zh:
代理自演使自主代理通过体验性试验和过敏以及环境反馈不断提高自身能力.
绝大多数现有作品将自我进取局限于非视觉领域,通过外部内存更新(例如:理性银行[20],ACE[34],RMM[25]),即时优化(例如:GEPA[1],机构风险管理[29]),自我改进代码合成(例如:达尔文·格德尔机器[31],格德尔代理[30]),或合成对抗推理(例如:R-Zero[9],帕索多布尔[35])等),为文字推理,符号操纵和算法任务制定反射策略.
最近,一些开创性的研究开始探索在多模式环境下的自演;然而,这些努力在很大程度上仍然局限于孤立的2D感知或静态图像互动(例如:VisPlay [8],Agent0-VL [16],ECHO [13],JarvisEvo [15].).
据我们所知,CineEvorve代表着将代理自我进取扩展为多镜头视频生成,结合创意方向和诊断批评,实现复杂电影合成中的迭接自我改进的第一个努力.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 数据集

blocks.en:
Generating multi-shot videos demands global visual planning and reflection across shot transitions.
Yet, existing datasets predominantly provide text-to-video pairs, lacking corrective demonstrations that are critical for models to autonomously plan and revise.
To address this limitation, we propose CineTraj, a dataset that captures the trajectory of multi-shot video generation (Fig. 2 ).
We use Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 7 ] as the teacher VLM, Director, and Critic, with the teacher Critic also annotating refreshed replay data.
blocks.zh:
制作多镜头视频需要全球视觉规划和跨镜头过渡的反思.
然而,现有的数据集主要提供从文本到视频的对等数据,缺乏对模型进行自主规划和修改至关重要的纠正性演示。
为了解决这一限制,我们提议使用CineTraj(图2)这一数据集来记录多镜头视频生成的轨迹。
我们使用双子座 3.1 Pro [7] 作为老师 VLM, 主任, 和批评, 老师 Critic 也注解了刷新的数据。

blocks.en:
Scene curation. To construct high-quality scenes with coherent narrative arcs, we collect cinematic footage from Condensed Movies [ 4 ] and CineBench [ 33 ] via a four-step curation pipeline: (i) Deduplication: performing movie-level filtering to eliminate overlapping titles between the two sources; (ii) Boundary detection: segmenting shot transitions across videos using TransNetV2 [ 24 ] ; (iii) Shot grouping: grouping consecutive shots under native scene boundaries via VLM-assessed narrative continuity to preserve complete context; and (iv) Quality screening: removing black borders and watermarks [ 26 ] , filtering out clips with low LAION aesthetic scores [ 22 ] , and pruning incoherent shot sequences via Gemini-3.1-Pro [ 7 ] .
This yields a high-fidelity corpus of verified source scenes with coherent visual storytelling.
blocks.zh:
场相会. 为了用连贯的叙事弧来构筑出高质量的场景,我们通过四步校正管道从Condensed Movies [4]和Cine Bench [33] 收集电影片段:(一) 复制:进行电影层面的过滤以消除两个来源之间的重叠标题;(二) 边界探测:利用TransNetV2 [24] 将镜头转换成片段; (三) 镜头组合:通过VLM评估的叙事连续性,将连续镜头组合在本土场景边界下,以保持完整的上下文; (四) 质量筛选:去掉黑色的边界和水印 [26],过滤出带有低LAION美学分的片段 [22],并通过Gemini-3.1-Pro [7] 播放不协调的镜头序列。
这产生了一个高真实度的、经核实的源场景,并有连贯的视觉故事。

Conditioned on ( x , 𝒟 shot ) (x,\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{shot}}) , a teacher Director then generates a hierarchical plan P P : (i) a global plan outlining narrative progression; and (ii) shot-level specifications designating camera framing, subject attributes, and tool-call prompts.
Subsequently, an external visual generation model [ 5 ] executes these tool calls to render the multi-shot storyboard frames B = ( b j ) j = 1 N B=(b_{j})_{j=1}^{N} , where N N is the number of shots.
This process outputs structured tuples ( x , P , B ) (x,P,B) , which serve as foundational demonstrations for defect critique and targeted revision.

blocks.en:
Data Summary. The constructed closed-loop trajectory dataset CineTraj provides structured supervision across three functional training objectives: (i) defect critique instances ( x , B , c ) (x,B,c) for training the Critic to predict shot defects and severity ratings; (ii) initial creation instances ( x , P , B ) (x,P,B) for supervising directorial global planning and tool execution; and (iii) targeted revision instances ( x , P , B , c , P ′ , B ′ ) (x,P,B,c,P^{\prime},B^{\prime}) for training directorial defect-driven repair.
We balance these three tasks with a sample distribution ratio of 4 : 2 : 4 4:2:4 , placing greater emphasis on critique and refinement.
In total, CineTraj comprises 30,000 verified trajectories for supervised policy warm-up and 10,000 diverse trajectories curated for alternating reinforcement learning 1 1 1 Dataset samples are provided in the supplementary materials. .
Furthermore, we curate an independent benchmark of 100 manually verified movie sequences with strong narrative coherence, strictly excluded from all training data.

blocks.en:
This section begins with an introduction to the training and inference paradigm (Sec. 4.1 ).
Then, we detail the Critic policy optimization to provide fine-grained visual critique via composite critic rewards (Sec. 4.2 ).
Next, we elaborate on the Director policy optimization to guide generative planning via multimodal director rewards (Sec. 4.3 ).
Finally, we present Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO) to stabilize alternating updates and promote mutual improvement between the Director and Critic (Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en:
Standard GRPO [ 23 ] estimates advantages through intra-group normalization, without explicitly referencing parent-storyboard or historical policy performance.
However, in alternating co-evolution, this relative comparison allows an inferior rollout to receive a falsely positive advantage whenever the entire group degrades, reinforcing counterproductive revisions.
To mitigate intra-group advantage inflation, we propose Evolutionary GRPO, which equips GRPO with revision safeguarding and historical anchoring (Fig. 3 (c)).

为了减轻集团内部的优势通货膨胀,我们提议采用进取式GRPO,使GRPO具备修订保障和历史锚地(图3(c))。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训详情

blocks.en:
We initialize the shared policy with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 3 ] , fine-tuning its language backbone while keeping the visual encoder frozen.
For generative execution, we use the four-step distilled FLUX.2-klein-9B [ 5 ] for storyboard generation and editing, and the eight-step distilled MiniMax-H3 Turbo [ 14 ] for video generation, with both visual backbones kept frozen.
Supervised policy warm-up is conducted for two epochs with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and an effective batch size of 64.
Subsequently, we perform five rounds of alternating reinforcement learning, with 64 optimization steps allocated per role in each round.
We use a learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} and a batch size of 16 16 .
All experiments are conducted on 16 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh:
我们与Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct[3]初始化共享政策,在保持视觉编码器被冻结的同时,微调其语言骨干.
对于基因执行,我们使用四相蒸馏的FLUX.2-克林-9B[5]来进行故事板生成和编辑,而八相蒸馏的MiniMax-H3 Turbo[14]来进行视频生成,两相视觉骨干一直被冷冻.
对两个学期进行了监督政策取暖,学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5 ;有效批量规模为64。
随后,我们进行了五轮交替强化学习,每轮每个角色分配64个优化步骤.
我们的学习率为10 - 6 10 - 6 和 16 的分批规模。
所有实验都用16个NVIDIA A100 GPU进行.

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We comprehensively evaluate CineEvolve across three aspects 4 4 4 Metric details are provided in the supplementary materials. : (i) Visual Quality and Alignment: we assess aesthetic appeal, technical fidelity, and text and video alignment using Aesthetic Quality (AQ) , Imaging Quality (IQ) , and Overall Consistency (OC) metrics from VBench [ 12 ] . (ii) Within-Shot Consistency: we evaluate the temporal stability of subjects and scene backgrounds across successive frames using Subject Consistency (SC) and Background Consistency (BC) metrics from VBench [ 12 ] . (iii) Cross-Shot Coherence: we evaluate visual continuity and narrative transitions across shots through four complementary metrics. Specifically, Entity Appearance Consistency (EAC) and Transition Contrast Agreement (TCA) measure cross-shot entity similarity and visual transition fidelity using DINOv2 [ 19 ] and CLIP [ 21 ] features. Additionally, Cross-shot Consistency (CSC) and Transition Logic Consistency (TLC) leverage a Vision-Language Model [ 7 ] evaluator to assess fine-grained entity attributes and inter-shot narrative progression, referencing the original story and source scene.
blocks.zh: 我们从三个方面全面评估演变情况 4 4 4 计量细节见补充材料。 (一)视觉质量和校正:我们利用美学质量(AQ),成像质量(IQ),和从V Bench[12]得出的总体一致性(OC)衡量标准,评估美学吸引力、技术忠诚度以及文本和视频校正度。 (二)内相一致性:我们利用从V Bench[12]中得出的主题一致性(SC)和背景一致性(BC)衡量标准,评价各个相继框架中的主体和场景背景的时间稳定性。 (三)跨相一致性:我们通过四个互补的衡量标准,评价视觉连续性和跨镜头的叙事过渡。 具体来说,实体外观一致性(EAC)和过渡对比协议(TCA)使用DINOv2[19]和CLIP[21]等特性测量了交叉射入实体的相似性和视觉过渡忠诚度. 此外,Cross-shot一致性(CSC)和过渡逻辑一致性(TLC)利用一个Vision-Language模型[7]评价员评估精细的实体属性和相接的叙事进展,并参考了原始故事和源场景.

blocks.en: 5.3 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 5.3 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en: We compare CineEvolve with six representative multi-shot video generation baselines, categorized into direct visual synthesis methods (HoloCine [ 18 ] , MultiShotMaster [ 27 ] , and ShotStream [ 17 ] ) and agentic methods (STAGE [ 32 ] , ViMax [ 11 ] , and CineCrew [ 6 ] ). All methods are evaluated on the proposed CineTraj benchmark (Sec. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们比较了CineEvolve与六个具有代表性的多镜头视频生成基线,分为直接视觉合成方法(HoloCine [18],MultiShotMaster [27],和ShotStream [17])和代理方法(STAGE [32],ViMax [11]和CineCrew [6]). 所有方法都按照拟议的CineTraj基准(第3节)进行评估。

blocks.en:
Fair Comparisons. To ensure a fair evaluation, all baselines share identical backbones with CineEvolve: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct serves as the VLM for agentic baselines, while FLUX.2-klein-9B and MiniMax-H3 Turbo are adopted as the unified image and video backbones.
For visual-based baselines, we supply detailed shot-level scripts pre-expanded by Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to ensure fairness.
blocks.zh:
公平比较. 为确保公平评价,所有基线都与CineEvolve共享相同的骨干:Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct作为代理基线的VLM,而FLUX.2-克林-9B和MiniMax-H3 Turbo则被采用为统一的图像和视频骨干.
对于基于视觉的基线,我们提供由Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct预先扩展的详细的相位脚本,以确保公平.

blocks.en:
Qualitative Comparisons. In Fig. 4 , we present visual quality comparison results with the aforementioned methods.
ShotStream [ 17 ] fails to strictly adhere to numerical constraints specified in the prompt ( e.g . , Fig. 4 first row, it violates the entity count by depicting multiple fish in shot 5, undermining prompt fidelity).
HoloCine [ 18 ] suffers from poor narrative progression and pacing ( e.g . , Fig. 4 second row, it abruptly omits the initial scene setup in shot 1, leading to a confusing storyline).
MultiShotMaster [ 27 ] exhibits notable visual artifacts and attribute instability ( e.g . , Fig. 4 third row, the character’s clothing color drastically alters alongside severe facial distortions across shot 3 and shot 4).
STAGE [ 32 ] suffers from severe attire drift across long-range transitions ( e.g . , Fig. 4 fourth row, the protagonist’s outfit inconsistently morphs between shot 1 and shot 6, breaking identity persistence).
CineCrew [ 6 ] opens too abruptly without establishing adequate character context ( e.g . , Fig. 4 fifth row, the absence of an establishing shot disrupts the cinematic pacing).
ViMax [ 11 ] struggles with environmental consistency across continuous scenes ( e.g . , Fig. 4 sixth row, an unnatural lighting discontinuity occurs between daylight and sunset across shot 4 to shot 6, creating an incoherent visual tone).
In contrast, CineEvolve preserves character identity and lighting consistency across all frames while depicting a coherent progression from the initial fishing scene to landing the catch and the final conversation, delivering a highly cinematic and coherent sequence.
blocks.zh:
定性比较. 在图4中,我们介绍了与上述方法的视觉质量比较结果。
ShootStream [17] 未能严格遵守提示中指定的数值限制(例如:图4第一行,它违反实体计数,在射击5中描绘多条鱼会破坏即时忠诚).
HoloCine [18] 遭遇了不良的叙事进展和节奏(例如:图4第二行,它突然省略了第1镜头中最初的场景设定,导致一个混乱的故事情节).
MultiShotMaster [27] 展出显著的视觉文物和属性不稳定性(例如:图4 第3行,人物的服装颜色与相片3和相片4的严重面部扭曲一起急剧地改变.
STAGE [32] 患有穿梭于远距离过渡的剧烈外衣漂移(例如:图4第四行,主角的装束在镜头1和镜头6之间不一致的形态,打破了身份持久性).
CineCrew [6] 开得太突然,没有建立适当的人物背景(例如:图4 第5行,没有固定镜头会打乱电影的节奏).
ViMax [11] 在连续场景中与环境一致性相抗争(例如:图4第六行,在日出和日出之间发生不自然的照明不连续,跨出第4至第6镜头,形成不连贯的视觉语气).
相反地,CineEvorve保持了所有框架的性格特征和照明一致性,同时描绘了从最初的捕鱼场面到登陆渔获物和最后对话的连贯进展,提供了高度的影视和连贯的顺序.

blocks.en:
Quantitative Comparisons. We present quantitative comparisons in Tab. 1 , where CineEvolve consistently outperforms existing multi-shot generation approaches across eight metrics.
This demonstrates its superior ability to create multi-shot cinematic videos with high aesthetic appeal and technical fidelity (AQ, IQ), faithful story-to-video alignment (OC), robust intra-shot temporal stability (SC, BC), reliable cross-shot visual persistence (EAC, CSC), and coherent narrative progression with logical transitions (TCA, TLC).

量比较. 我们在表1中提出了定量比较,其中CineEvolve在8个度量标准上一贯优于现有的多镜头生成方法。
这表明,它具有超强的能力,能够制作具有高审美吸引力和技术忠诚度(AQ, IQ)的多镜头影视视频,忠实的故事与视频对接(OC),强烈的镜头内时间稳定性(SC, BC),可靠的交叉镜头视觉持久性(EAC, CSC),以及带有逻辑过渡的连贯叙事进展(TCA, TLC).

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of our key design and training paradigms, we construct four ablation variants. The evaluation scores and visual results of the ablation study are presented in Table 1 and Fig. 5 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们关键设计和培训范式的有效性,我们构建出四个消化变体。 表1和图5分别列出了该研究的评价分数和视觉结果。

blocks.en:
SFT Only. We remove alternating reinforcement learning to retain only the supervised warm-up policy. Without iterative trial-and-error reflection, the model fails to continuously refine its directorial planning and diagnostic precision, yielding degraded performance across all metrics.
As shown in Fig. 5 (row 1), the generated sequence suffers from chronological reversals and environmental drift, where a baked roll prematurely appears in Shot 2 before the baking stage.
blocks.zh:
SFT 软件 仅此而已 我们取消了交替强化学习,只保留监督的热身政策。 如果没有反复的试验和反射,模型无法不断完善其指导规划和诊断精度,导致所有衡量标准的业绩退化。
如图5(第1行)所示,生成的序列发生时间倒转和环境漂移,在烘焙阶段前,Shoot 2中过早地出现烤卷.

blocks.en:
Fixed Critic. We freeze the Critic after supervised warm-up while optimizing only the Director during reinforcement learning. Lacking dynamic diagnostic adaptation, the static Critic fails to provide informative feedback across directorial rollouts. Thus, this variant degrades cross-shot consistency (lower EAC and CSC scores).
As shown in Fig. 5 (row 2), it fails to preserve object-level consistency, resulting in changes in the count and spatial arrangement of bread rolls on the tray between Shot 2 and Shot 4.
blocks.zh:
固定批评. 在有监督的热身后,我们冻结批评,同时在强化学习时,只优化主任。 由于缺乏动态诊断适应,静态批评未能提供全导演推出过程中的翔实反馈. 因此,这个变体会降解出交叉射出相通性(EAC和CSC分数较低).
如图5(第2行)所示,它未能保持对象级别的一致性,导致Shot 2和Shot 4之间托盘上面包卷的计数和空间安排发生变化.

blocks.en:
Separate Policies. We optimize the Director and Critic separately rather than within a unified model. Without unified parameter sharing, the model loses cognitive synergy in cinematic grammar, resulting in degraded transition coherence (lower TLC score).
As shown in Fig. 5 (row 3), it ambiguously conflates loading and unloading the oven in Shot 4, disrupting the transition from raw dough to baked bread.
blocks.zh:
单独的政策。 我们单独优化主任和批评,而不是在一个统一的模式内。 没有统一的参数共享,模型在电影语法中失去了认知协同,导致转型一致性退化(TLC分数更低).
如图5(第3行)所示,它在Shot 4中模糊地将烤箱装入并卸下,扰乱了从生面团到烤面包的过渡.

blocks.en:
Original GRPO. We replace E-GRPO with standard GRPO, removing revision safeguarding and historical anchoring. Without baseline calibration, standard GRPO falsely rewards defective candidates that rank highest in a poor group, encouraging flawed revisions that harm entity consistency and transition logic (lower CSC and TLC scores).
As shown in Fig. 5 (row 4), it exhibits identity and state flickering, where the woman’s attire abruptly changes from long to short sleeves between Shot 2 and Shot 3.
blocks.zh:
原创GRPO. 我们用标准的GRPO取代了E-GRPO,取消了修订保障和历史锚地. 如果不进行基线校准,标准的GPRO就会错误地奖励在贫穷群体中排名最高的有缺陷的候选人,鼓励有缺陷的修订,损害实体的一致性和过渡逻辑(低于CSC和TLC的分数)。
如图5(第4行)所示,它显示了身份和状态闪烁,妇女的衣服在Shot 2和Shot 3之间突然从长袖变为短袖.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present CineEvolve , an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation.
By unifying the Director and Critic roles within a single vision-language policy, CineEvolve realizes iterative multi-shot synthesis via alternating reinforcement learning.
To sustain stable co-evolution, we introduce role-specific rewards that couple fine-grained diagnostic fidelity with self-evaluative feedback, complemented by E-GRPO to calibrate policy optimization.
Furthermore, we construct CineTraj , a large-scale cinematic trajectory dataset comprising 40K samples for cinematic multi-shot video generation.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve significantly outperforms existing approaches in both narrative coherence and visual execution, establishing a promising paradigm for autonomous cinematic creation.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍 CineEvorve, 一个代理性的自我演变框架 电影多镜头视频生成。
CineEvorve通过将主任和批评作用统一在一个单一的愿景语言政策中,通过交替强化学习实现迭代多镜头合成.
为了保持稳定的共同演变,我们引入了特定角色的奖励,即夫妇之间精细的诊断忠诚和自我评价反馈,辅之以E-GRPO来校正政策优化.
此外,我们建造了CineTraj,一个由40K个样本组成的大型电影轨迹数据集,用于电影多镜头录像制作。
广泛的实验表明,CineEvolve在叙事一致性和视觉执行方面明显地超越了现有方法,为自主电影创作确立了有希望的范式.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
CineEvolve primarily performs defect diagnosis and targeted revision at the storyboard level.
Although multi-shot narrative consistency and cinematic composition are predominantly governed by keyframe storyboards, subtle motion artifacts can still arise during subsequent video synthesis, which remain outside the current feedback loop.
We expect these residual artifacts to diminish naturally as foundational video generation backbones continue to advance.
blocks.zh:
CineEvolve主要在故事板层面进行缺陷诊断和定向修订.
虽然多镜头的叙事一致性和影视构成主要由键盘故事板来规范,但微妙的运动文物在之后的视频合成中仍然可能出现,这些作品仍然处于当前反馈回路之外.
我们期望这些残存文物会随着基础视频生成骨干不断进步而自然减少.
